mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the arrangement of data (observations of a variable) either in an ascending or descending order of magnitude."
An array is the arrangement of data (observations of a variable) either in an ascending or descending order of magnitude.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the element of a population which need to be selected during sampling."
Sampling units are the element of a population which need to be selected during sampling.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with scientific method of collecting, organising, summarising, presenting and analysing masses of numerical data so as to comprehend the essential features and relationship of the data."

Statistics is concerned with scientific method of collecting, organising, summarising, presenting and analysing masses of numerical data so as to comprehend the essential features and relationship of the data.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a non-parametric statistic which is used to determine the difference between expected and the observed results."
The chi square is a non-parametric statistic which is used to determine the difference between expected and the observed results.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the standard deviation divided by the mean and multiplied by 100."
Coefficient of variation is defined as the standard deviation divided by the mean and multiplied by 100.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to analyse and summarise data while inferential statistics is used to draw conclusions on the population based on the analysis of the sample. 3."
The descriptive statistics is used to analyse and summarise data while inferential statistics is used to draw conclusions on the population based on the analysis of the sample. 3.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sample estimator of the parameter value been tested. 4."
The t statistics is the sample estimator of the parameter value been tested. 4.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a subset of a population which is usually taken from a population using an appropriate technique."
A sample is a subset of a population which is usually taken from a population using an appropriate technique.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the upper class limit of the class just before it plus the lower class limit of that class and dividing by 2."
The lower class boundary is the upper class limit of the class just before it plus the lower class limit of that class and dividing by 2.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a measure of the degree of association between dependent and independent variables."
Correlation is a measure of the degree of association between dependent and independent variables.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the one whose behaviour is been investigated as been influenced by the independent variables (Xs)."
The dependent variable (Y) is the one whose behaviour is been investigated as been influenced by the independent variables (Xs).
fib: ______ is the median of the distribution.
value of X
The value of X is the median of the distribution.
______ is called a score or observation while a collection of pieces of data pertaining to a topic is called variable.
piece of data
A piece of data is called a score or observation while a collection of pieces of data pertaining to a topic is called variable.
______ is the degree to which numerical data tend to spread about an average value of the data.
dispersion or variation
The dispersion or variation is the degree to which numerical data tend to spread about an average value of the data.
______ is used to mean the totality of cases in an investigation.
Population or universe
Population or universe is used to mean the totality of cases in an investigation.
______ is a circular diagram with the circumference of 3600, in which each item is represented by a sector whose area is proportional to the percentage or relative frequency of the total.
pie chart
A pie chart is a circular diagram with the circumference of 3600, in which each item is represented by a sector whose area is proportional to the percentage or relative frequency of the total.
______ is the commonly used measure of dispersion of a set of observation.
Standard deviation
Standard deviation is the commonly used measure of dispersion of a set of observation.
______ are the smallest (lower class limit) and the largest (upper class limit) observation in each class.
class limits
The class limits are the smallest (lower class limit) and the largest (upper class limit) observation in each class.
______ is used to compare the significant difference in several means at the same time for the analysis of variance (ANOVA).
F distribution
F distribution is used to compare the significant difference in several means at the same time for the analysis of variance (ANOVA).
______ is a line graph joining the mid-point of the class interval.
frequency polygon
A frequency polygon is a line graph joining the mid-point of the class interval.
______ is a graphical display of frequency distribution in bars.
bar chart

______ is used to determine the difference between expected and the observed results.
chi square distribution
A chi square distribution is used to determine the difference between expected and the observed results.
